Re-tint any panel borders, pills or outlines that matched the old background so they still sit naturally on the new one. Text colours stay as the reference unless contrast fails, then darken/lighten minimally. SWAP ONLY: (a) their product → the attached LACALUT reference packshot, placed in the SAME spot, SAME scale, SAME angle and SAME lighting as their product (if their product is held, ours is held the same way); (b) their brand name, logo and wording → the LACALUT wording below. Where a line is marked "keep", reproduce it exactly; where it is rewritten, keep the SAME size, weight, colour, case and position for the new words.

1. CANVAS
Aspect ratio: 4:5 (portrait).
Overall style: Hybrid. Combines a social media user interface screenshot (Facebook comment), scientific imagery (microscopic before/after scans), and a product photograph.
Dominant background: Solid light blue.

2. LAYOUT GRID
Top header band: 5% (for "1 million+ happy customers").
Facebook comment zone: 28% (includes profile picture, comment box, reactions, and replies link).
Before/After image zone: 25% (two side-by-side images).
Descriptive text zone: 15% (multi-line headline).
Product shot zone: 27% (toothpaste tube, angled from bottom right).

3. TEXT
"1 million+ happy customers": Top right, small, regular weight, sentence case, dark grey, sans serif, right aligned.
"Dianne Somerville": Upper-middle zone, inside comment box, large, bold weight, title case, black, sans serif, left aligned.
"This toothpaste has really helped my gum recession and sensitivity.": Upper-middle zone, inside comment box, large, regular weight, sentence case, black, sans serif, left aligned.
"3w": Upper-middle zone, below comment box, small, regular weight, lowercase, medium grey, sans serif, left aligned.
"Like": Upper-middle zone, below comment box, small, regular weight, title case, medium grey, sans serif, left aligned.
"Reply": Upper-middle zone, below comment box, small, regular weight, title case, medium grey, sans serif, left aligned.
"View 3 replies": Upper-middle zone, below comment box, small, regular weight, title case, medium grey, sans serif, left aligned.
"14": Upper-middle zone, right of comment box, small, regular weight, numeric, white, sans serif, centered, inside a small red rounded rectangle pill.
"before": Mid-section, top left of left image, small, regular weight, lowercase, dark grey, sans serif, centered, inside a small light grey rounded rectangle pill.
"after": Mid-section, top left of right image, small, regular weight, lowercase, dark grey, sans serif, centered, inside a small light grey rounded rectangle pill.
"LACALUT Sensitive seals the microscopic holes and cracks that make teeth and gums so sensitive.": Lower-middle zone, medium, bold weight for "LACALUT Sensitive", regular weight for rest, sentence case, black, sans serif, centered.
"LACALUT": Bottom zone, on product, huge, bold weight, all caps, bright red, sans serif, left aligned on product.
"sensitive": Bottom zone, on product, large, regular weight, lowercase, white, sans serif, left aligned on green background on product.
"SENSITIVE FORMULA": Bottom zone, on product, small, regular weight, all caps, white, sans serif, curved along top edge of circular green badge.
"EXTRA-GENTLE CLEANING": Bottom zone, on product, small, regular weight, all caps, white, sans serif, curved along bottom edge of circular green badge.
"TREAT PAIN-SENSITIVE TEETH // REMINERALISES THE TOOTH ENAMEL // PREVENTS TOOTH DECAY // MILD AND GENTLE CLEANING // STRENGTHENS GUMS // REMINERALISIERT DEN ZAHNSCHMELZ": Bottom zone, on product, tiny, regular weight, all caps, dark grey, sans serif, left aligned on product.

4. PRODUCT
What it is: A white toothpaste tube with a red and green label.
Where it sits: Bottom zone, extending from the bottom right corner upwards and towards the left. The bottom and right edges of the tube are cropped by the canvas edge.
Approx % of canvas height: The visible portion of the tube is approximately 30% of the canvas height.
Angle: Tilted upwards from the bottom right, with the top of the tube pointing towards the upper left. The label faces the viewer at a slight angle.
Lighting: Even, soft lighting from the front/top, highlighting the tube's contours and creating subtle depth.
Shadow/reflection: A subtle, soft, light grey drop shadow is cast beneath the tube on the light blue background, suggesting it is slightly raised. No visible reflections.
Held or standing: Standing/resting on a surface, not held.

5. PEOPLE / PROPS / SCENE
People: Dianne Somerville. A circular profile picture in the upper-middle zone, showing a woman with dark hair, wearing a light-colored top, slightly blurred, looking towards the camera. Cropped to head and shoulders.
Props:
Facebook comment box: A large, white, rounded rectangular box in the upper-middle zone, with a subtle light grey drop shadow. Contains the user's name and comment.
Microscopic images: Two side-by-side square images in the mid-section. Both are grayscale, showing highly magnified surfaces. The left image ("before") shows a porous, irregular surface with many small, deep, dark holes. The right image ("after") shows a smoother, more uniform surface with fewer, shallower, lighter irregularities and more defined ridges.
Scene: A solid, uniform light blue background.
Camera angle and lens feel: The overall ad has a clean, digital feel. The product shot is a standard product photography angle. The microscopic images are scientific scans. The Facebook comment is a digital rendering of a user interface element.

6. GRAPHIC DEVICES
Facebook comment box: White rounded rectangle with a soft light grey drop shadow, positioned in the upper-middle zone.
Profile picture circle: Dark grey circle border around Dianne Somerville's photo, inside the comment box.
Like button: Small blue rounded rectangle pill with a white thumbs-up icon, positioned below the comment box, right of "Reply".
Heart emoji: Small red heart icon, positioned right of the blue like button.
Reaction count pill: Small red rounded rectangle pill with white text "14", positioned right of the heart emoji.
"before" label: Small light grey rounded rectangle pill with dark grey text, positioned at the top left corner of the left microscopic image.
"after" label: Small light grey rounded rectangle pill with dark grey text, positioned at the top left corner of the right microscopic image.
Product branding:
Red "LACALUT" text on the tube.
Green rectangular background for "sensitive" text on the tube.
Circular green badge on the tube, containing a white stylized tooth icon with two curved lines around it, and curved text.

7. COLOUR PALETTE
Light Blue: #C9E8ED (Dominant background)
White: #FFFFFF (Facebook comment box, product tube, some text, icons)
Dark Grey/Black: #222222 (Most text, microscopic images, profile picture border)
Medium Grey: #888888 (Secondary text like "3w", "Like", "Reply", "View 3 replies")
Bright Red: #E0212B (LACALUT text, heart emoji, reaction count pill)
Teal Green: #00A99D (Product "sensitive" background, circular badge)
Facebook Blue: #1877F2 (Like button background)

8. MOOD / FINISH
Lighting: Bright, even, and soft, creating a clean and professional look. The product is well-lit without harsh shadows.
Contrast: High contrast for text against backgrounds, moderate contrast for images.
Photo vs render: A mix. The product tube appears to be a high-quality product photograph. The microscopic images are scientific scans. The Facebook UI elements are digital renders/mockups.
Any filter or grain: No apparent filters or grain. The overall finish is very clean, sharp, and digital.

TOP-RIGHT small line: keep "1 million+ happy customers" exactly.

White pill labels on the panels now read "tongue · before" (left) and "tongue · after" (right), same pill style and size as the reference.
SUB-LINE under the panels (same two-line style, same size, centred): bold "LACALUT Flora" then regular weight: "clears the bacteria on your tongue that release the sulphur gases behind bad breath."
PRODUCT: the attached LACALUT Flora tube replaces the Sensitive tube in the SAME bottom position, SAME angle, SAME crop off the bottom-right edge, label facing camera, entering from the LEFT. Keep its real navy/white label exactly as supplied; never let the crop cut the LACALUT wordmark.

LACALUT PRODUCT (from the SECOND attached image onward): reproduce the real packaging EXACTLY — shape, label layout, colours, logo and wording; real proportions (a tall slim 75ml tube, never squat); only the LACALUT wordmark and variant name may read clearly, all small printed pack text stays in its ORIGINAL GERMAN and softly out of focus — NEVER legible English health words on the pack. STRICT COMPLIANCE (cosmetic-only, non-negotiable): never show or write gingivitis, periodontitis, gum disease, halitosis, reverses the condition, graphic bleeding gums close-up, bleeding, reduces bleeding, stops bleeding, stops gum bleeding, gum bleeding, soothes, soothes irritation, irritation, inflammation, reduces inflammation, anti-inflammatory, heals, calms, closes gum pockets, kills bacteria, kills the bacteria, clinically proven, clinically tested, clinical trial, gum health, oral health, dental health, healthy tissue, healthy gums, dentist approved, dentist recommended, 0% alcohol, alcohol-free; never a medical cross, never a disease or treatment claim, never "clinically proven", never a doctor endorsement unless the reference's equivalent line was explicitly rewritten by the art director. If a competitor line would breach this, keep its size/position but soften the wording to a cosmetic feel/benefit. TITLE CASE ALL HEADERS (Quan's #1 header rule, never break): the headline AND every sub-headline are written in Title Case — capitalise every significant word; small words (a, an, the, and, or, in, of, to, for, with, on, at) stay lowercase unless they are the first word. This overrides the reference ad's own casing (even if their headline is in sentence case). Body lines and fine print keep the casing given in the changes. Do NOT add any headline, badge, trust seal, star row, review, CTA pill, URL, price or logo that the reference does not have. Do NOT remove any element the reference has. Keep the reference's element order and styling top to bottom, and use the extra vertical space to make the main elements BIGGER — never add new elements, never leave an empty band. 4:5 portrait aspect ratio, full-bleed edge to edge. Output ONE finished image.
